name: buy-call
description: Buy an open call option with ETH: pay its premium and receive the OptionNFT giving the right to buy the tokens at the strike until expiry. Send maxPremium as value; the Router refunds any excess.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Option id (the OptionNFT token id). Read it from kyte.sh/market, the Kyte MCP (find_offers, get_positions) or the OfferCreated event.

inputs.name: maxPremium
inputs.description: Most you will pay in wei; the offer's premium or slightly above. Also sent as the transaction value.
